text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
After running in the Nippon Derby, 
injuries were discovered in both Chiyono O 
and Ardan-senpai. They won't be able to 
race for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“But if the two of them are together, I 
know they can return to racing! And then, 
they'll put on another absolute classic 
just like the Japanese Derby, I know it!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno and I decided to do our best so we 
can be the greatest rivals for both of 
them when they return to racing!
